description: This file is a Java interface named ProductService that defines methods for managing products in an e-commerce system, including adding descriptions, retrieving products by various criteria, and listing products.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: An interface defining service methods for product management, including CRUD operations and various retrieval methods for products based on different criteria.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Adds a product description to a specified product; can throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a product in a specific language.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID, localized to a specific language and locale.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products under a category, localized to a specific language and locale.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products for given category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SEO URL within a store for a specified locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SKU or code for a specified language.
